findings.detail: The Recommendations section lists actions but does not explain why these allocations serve the clients’ objectives. Apart from the total available to invest, it leaves the amounts for the proposed contributions and investments to be confirmed, so it does not yet meet the specification’s requirement to explain the recommendations and the amounts involved.
report_quote: We recommend using both ISA allowances for the new tax year. We recommend making pension contributions into both SIPPs up to the appropriate level.
We recommend placing the remaining balance into a new jointly-held investment account. [ADVISER TO CONFIRM #10: the balance placed into the new account]

findings.detail: The meeting note specifically records a decision to leave the offshore bond unchanged and revisit it. The report turns that into a broader statement about making no other changes, losing the emphasis on the bond decision.
report_quote: We recommend making no other changes at this time and revisiting at the next review.

findings.detail: The report does not leak the internal notes, but it overlooks their instruction to attend to the different forms and timings of the sale proceeds. It identifies the amount available now without explaining that a separate earnout of up to £400,000 is contingent, has not been received and may be paid over the next two years.
report_quote: James completed the sale of his company in April.
The money available to invest now is £650,000.

findings.detail: The long introductory list repeats the account table and is hard to follow; ‘your’ is also less clear than naming the owners of joint accounts. ‘Disinvesting’ and the unexplained abbreviation ‘GIA’ make the advice less accessible than it could be.
report_quote: Further to our recent discussions, we are writing to set out our advice in relation to the accounts comprising James's Stocks & Shares ISA held with Holloway, your General Investment Account held with Holloway, James's SIPP held with Brightwell, your General Investment Account held with Brightwell, your Offshore Investment Bond held with Meridian, Caroline's Stocks & Shares ISA held with Holloway, Caroline's SIPP held with Brightwell and your New joint account.
We recommend disinvesting a portion of the Holloway joint GIA and rebalancing it.

findings.detail: Each marker identifies a specific missing amount, tax point or charge rate and the account or platform concerned.
